categories.main_business_segments: Chinasoft International operates primarily in two segments: Technical Professional Services Group (TPG), providing IT solutions and outsourcing services to banks, financial institutions, telecom carriers, and large multinational companies; and Internet IT Services Group (IIG), offering IT solutions, outsourcing, and training services to government, tobacco industry, and smaller companies. The company also focuses on full-stack AI products and services, ERP and digital transformation services, HarmonyOS smart IoT and digital twin solutions, intelligent cloud services, and overseas services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies including DeepSeek large models, Ascend AI computing infrastructure, and HarmonyOS AI-native operating systems. It employs integrated platforms such as ARK Lumi, ARK Foundry, and JointPilot for AI agent development, model training, and inference. Manufacturing and development include software-hardware integrated solutions, cloud computing, edge intelligence, and AI-powered ERP systems, with a strong emphasis on domestic technology stacks and open-source ecosystems like OpenHarmony and openEuler.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chinasoft serves a broad range of customers including government agencies, financial institutions, energy and power companies, manufacturing enterprises, telecom operators, and smart city projects. Major clients include Huawei, HSBC, China Mobile, China Telecom, Tencent, Alibaba, Ping An, Bank of Communications, China Construction Bank, PetroChina, CNOOC, and State Grid. The company targets industries such as power, finance, government, transportation, public utilities, and manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations are primarily based in the People's Republic of China, with significant presence in economically developed regions such as the Greater Bay Area, Yangtze River Delta, and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei. It has expanded overseas with R&D and delivery centers in Hong Kong, Thailand, Japan, Singapore, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, serving markets across Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, and beyond.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chinasoft International operates mainly as a midstream and downstream service provider in the IT and AI ecosystem, delivering software development, IT outsourcing, cloud services, AI model training and deployment, and digital transformation consulting. It also develops proprietary software and hardware products, positioning itself as an integrator and enabler within the AI and digital infrastructure supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes full-stack AI innovation, including AI computing infrastructure, model training, AI-native ERP systems, and HarmonyOS ecosystem development. It invests heavily in R&D for AI platforms, intelligent agents, and industry-specific AI solutions. Strategic collaborations with Huawei and other partners focus on AI model adaptation, cloud intelligence, edge computing, and domestic technology localization. The Group also emphasizes AI-powered delivery methodologies and intelligent software factories to enhance digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Chinasoft generates revenue primarily through IT service contracts including project-based development, outsourcing services, and consulting. It also earns from sales of proprietary and third-party software and hardware products. The company provides cloud transformation services, AI model training and deployment, and licensing of AI platforms. Recurring service revenue from long-term contracts with large enterprises and government entities forms a significant portion of its income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Chinasoft positions itself as a leading AI and digital transformation service provider in China and the Asia-Pacific region, with a strong partnership with Huawei. It holds a leading market share in Huawei Cloud's CTSP ecosystem and is a top-tier provider in sectors such as finance, energy, government, and smart city solutions. The company is recognized for its full-stack AI capabilities and HarmonyOS ecosystem leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Chinasoft reported revenue of approximately RMB 16.95 billion, with a slight 1.0% year-over-year decrease. Service revenue was RMB 16.31 billion, down 1.9%. Profit attributable to owners was RMB 512.9 million, a 28.1% decline mainly due to increased bad debt provisions and reduced government subsidies. The company invested RMB 906 million in R&D. Since its 2003 listing, it has achieved a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 24.6% in revenue and 30.8% in service revenue, reflecting strong long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chinasoft emphasizes its full-stack AI capabilities, integrating hardware, algorithms, platforms, and solutions to enable comprehensive AI adoption and business transformation. Its proprietary AI platforms (DeepSeek, ARK Lumi, JointPilot), domestic ERP systems, and HarmonyOS-based IoT solutions provide secure, localized, and customizable offerings. The company leverages strategic partnerships, especially with Huawei, to deliver cutting-edge AI and cloud services, positioning itself as a pioneer and leader in AI-driven digital transformation with strong industry-specific expertise.
